items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.implication: Bills WR targets to Palmer/others with Moore out.

items.text: Actives today include Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Rico Dowdle, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane.
items.implication: Williams returns post-hamstring; Olave/Kamara full go for Saints; Dowdle active for Steelers.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for returnees; Kamara lead back.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Browns; only Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (just signed) available in backfield.
items.implication: Browns RB depth collapses to undrafted/practice squad options; avoid Judkins entirely.
items.opportunity: McLaughlin/Estime committee for residual work vs BAL.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Groin injury; late addition to report confirmed out.
items.implication: Colts TE streaming void; targets redistribute to Downs/others.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs, Mo Alie-Cox or streamers like Freiermuth/Juwan Johnson gain.

items.text: Lamar Jackson out again (ankle); Jalen Hurts on IR/out indefinitely (blood clot); Huntley/McKee start.
items.why: Ongoing ankle for Lamar; clot for Hurts sidelined longer.
items.implication: Backup QBs; Eagles RBs already thin (Barkley out).

items.text: Whoa on Tyler Warren inactive (surprising despite report); Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
items.implication: Pivot to available TEs with better matchups/roles.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today.
items.why: Knee issue but full practice Friday; confirmed active.
items.implication: Spears-Pollard split continues; Spears viable PPR flex.
items.opportunity: Pass-catching work for Spears behind Pollard.

items.text: If starting NYG RB still Cam Skattebo for explosiveness/TD upside vs NO but riskier flex (RB28 ranks) than prior RB2; prefer over DK sometimes, Najee RB33.
items.why: Explosiveness best TD chance despite rotation downgrade and preseason hate flag.
items.implication: Flex start ok but not locked RB2; monitor snap share.
items.opportunity: Still has big-play path in split.
items.conflict: Conflicts with pure usage/efficiency data favoring more even or Najee lean.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th/43 in rush YOE and has 4 fumbles (1 lost); Giants expected to increase Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still mixed in.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles per beat/ sources; all 4 RBs active.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris larger role vs NO.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Skattebo explosiveness for TD chance.

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson expected to play and confirmed in broader actives context.
items.why: ETR weekend summary listed expected; Schefter/actives corroborate.
items.implication: Brown back from IR for Patriots; Henderson role intact for NE.
items.opportunity: Brown target share upgrade; Henderson carries/routes.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4), Drake London vs CHI (WR6), George Kittle vs WSH (TE3) due to Commanders defense buffet and reliable usage.
items.why: Soft matchups vs WAS pass D; volume bankable for London.
items.implication: Strong start signals for these pass catchers.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5), Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9) for volume vs leaky run Ds; Kyren elite usage, Javonte GL role.
items.why: Volume + favorable run defenses; goal-line for Javonte.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34), Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18) on ugly matchups and shaky QB/feeding.
Hates J.K. Dobbins vs SEA, Bo Nix vs SEA, Justin Herbert @ KC on tough defenses and low totals/scoring ruts.
items.why: Elite pass/run Ds and poor team environments.

items.text: Loves Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2) in high-scoring spot vs defense that can't slow pass.
items.why: Commanders soft vs QB; shootout potential.
